## Passages
RESULT [weeds]: With 1% labels: +13.8 AP50-95 over supervised on CottonWeedDet12, +12.4 on CropAndWeed, +8.2 on Palmer amaranth, +6.7 on RoboWeedMap and +5.3 on RadishWheat.
US [weeds]: Shows that pseudo-labelling works on CottonWeedDet12 itself, in-domain. A dual threshold (trusted / uncertain / discard) is a direct design for how the labeller agent's outputs enter training: only the trusted tier goes into an increment, and the uncertain tier goes to review.
CORRECTION [weeds]: Confirmed from Table 2: gains at 1% labels over supervised are +13.8 (CottonWeedDet12), +12.4 (CropAndWeed), +8.2 (Palmer amaranth), +6.7 (RoboWeedMap) and +5.3 (RadishWheat) AP50-95. On design: unreliable pseudo-labels (between two dynamic thresholds) get an unsupervised loss with soft class target
